prompt: Using the provided image, change only the condition of the sign: the firing has just stopped and it has been shot to pieces. Keep the camera, the street and the shapes and positions of the letters exactly the same. Every bulb is dead, leaving dead cream troughs of broken sockets. The blue tube is shattered and dark. The red disc is pitted with dark iron craters and bullet holes. The black board is riddled with hundreds of holes, and one lamp behind the board, the one light left, sends thin white beams through every hole into slow smoke. The beams' soft glow keeps the letters and the red disc just visible. The wet cobbles mirror the points of light. True black all around. Thanks.
